# iGROW WORKS

> Creative post-production and video editing studio led by Director Nomair, specializing in cinematic pacing, documentary editing, narrative fiction drama, sound design, and color grading.

## Studio Overview
- **Studio Name**: iGROW WORKS
- **Official Domain**: https://igrow.now/
- **Director & Lead Editor**: Nomair (Over 500+ career projects mastered)
- **Lead Screenwriter & Story Architect**: Marie Bu
- **Direct Contact**: nomair@igrow.now
- **Governing Year**: 2026

## Core Disciplines & Capabilities
1. **Directorial Cut & Narrative Pacing**: Screenplay structure, dramatic tension arcs, and rhythmic video editing.
2. **Documentary & Narrative Fiction**: Full post-production pipeline for long-form documentaries and commercials.
3. **Cinema-Grade Sound Design & Color Grading**: Multi-layer audio mixing, sound architecture, and DaVinci-grade color grading.
4. **Client Portal & Dedicated Pipeline**: Frame-accurate review, secure cloud footage ingest, rough cut review, and 4K master delivery.
